# Demand forecasting evaluation

- Data source: **synthetic_demo** (SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — not real sales)
- History: 730 days up to 2026-11-09, 180 product x location series
- Target: average daily demand over the horizon, measured on in-stock days only
- Split: time-based hold-out (last 25 % of weekly forecast origins), training windows purged so they end before the test period
- Errors are in units of total demand per product-location over the horizon

## 7-day horizon — selected: Gradient boosting (histogram, Poisson loss)

Test period 2026-05-26 → 2026-11-09 · 12733 training / 4232 test samples

| Model | MAE | RMSE | WAPE | MAPE (demand ≥ 5) | Bias |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Gradient boosting (histogram, Poisson loss) ✅ | 5.81 | 9.27 | 25.6 % | 28.4 % | -2.9 % |
| Random forest | 5.86 | 9.14 | 25.8 % | 29.5 % | -0.2 % |
| Linear regression (ridge) | 5.97 | 9.13 | 26.3 % | 30.5 % | -0.3 % |
| Moving average, 28 days (baseline) | 6.16 | 9.59 | 27.1 % | 30.2 % | -2.5 % |
| Seasonal naive, same weeks last year (baseline) | 8.21 | 12.43 | 36.1 % | 42.1 % | 2.0 % |

Improvement of the selected model over the 28-day moving average: 5.8 % lower MAE.

Stockout handling, scored against the simulated **true** demand (incl. demand lost to stockouts):

| Training data | MAE | Bias |
|---|---:|---:|
| Stockout-aware (in-stock days only) | 5.85 | -3.5 % |
| Naive (sold-out days = zero demand) | 5.98 | -5.3 % |
